# Twitch VOD Downloader

> Free, open-source Windows app that saves Twitch VODs, past broadcasts and clips from a URL to a local folder, in the maximum quality the channel serves.

Twitch VOD Downloader is a free, open-source desktop app for Windows 10 and 11. Paste a Twitch VOD, clip or channel URL, choose a folder and download. The app resolves the media with yt-dlp, shows percentage, speed and remaining time, and writes the file locally in the format Twitch serves, usually MP4, without re-encoding. There is no account, no installer and no telemetry. It does not bypass private, restricted or expired content.

## Key features
- Download public Twitch VODs and clips by pasting their URL
- Maximum quality the channel serves, commonly 1080p60
- Live progress: percentage, speed and time remaining
- Destination folder selection
- No account, no installer, no extra dependencies
- Free, open source, MIT-licensed
- Windows 10 and 11, distributed as a standalone .exe

- The website shows Google AdSense only after consent; the app contains no ads.
- Language: Spanish interface and documentation (target audience: Spanish-speaking streamers and editors).
